name: Launch dates

subjectOf.text: The tokens in the sample of the top 100 cryptocurrencies were launched between January 2009 and March 2018, with the greatest number of top 100 coins launched in a single month occurring in November 2017.
subjectOf.abstract: This stable growth of new coins occurred with the greatest number of the top 100 coins by month launched in November of 2017.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860
scope_conditions: launch date measured by ICO start date or first trade date
